name: SnapKV
summary: Score on the last few steps only, then max-pool across neighbouring positions so an important token drags its neighbours in with it. A forgetting window plus a defence against keeping half a phrase.

source.title: SnapKV: LLM Knows What You are Looking for Before Generation

params.name: budget
params.description: Maximum token positions kept in the cache.

params.name: recentWindow
params.description: The most recent positions, never evicted whatever their score.

params.name: obsWindow
params.description: How many recent decode steps the score is summed over.

params.name: poolKernel
params.description: Width of the max-pool across neighbouring kept positions. Must be odd.
